p='src/intake.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('HEADER_KEY_PROVIDERS = frozenset({"northwind"})','HEADER_KEY_PROVIDERS = frozenset({"northwind", "harbor"})')
s=s.replace('    # The body event id is the replay identity on purpose: the Idempotency-Key header is a per-delivery gateway trace and changes when a provider retries (PAY-418).\n',
'''    # Providers in HEADER_KEY_PROVIDERS keep the Idempotency-Key header stable
    # across retries but mint a new body event id (po_1844 -> po_1844.2), so
    # the header is their replay identity. For everyone else the header is a
    # per-delivery gateway trace that changes on retry (PAY-418), so the body
    # event id is the replay identity.
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat >> tests/test_intake.py <<'EOF'


def test_harbor_retry_with_a_new_event_id_is_not_applied_twice():
    intake = Intake()
    first = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    again = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844.2", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    assert first.applied is True
    assert again.applied is False
    assert again.duplicate is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 18_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 1


def test_distinct_harbor_keys_both_settle():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6", amount=18_000))
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_2", "1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e", amount=2_000))
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 20_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 2
EOF
